LanguageData.Raven_Building_Obelisk.label: (Raven) Obelisk
LanguageData.Raven_Building_Obelisk.description: A Raven obelisk cast in dark alloy. Golden energy flows steadily along its etched patterns, keeping its majestic and striking silhouette visible even in dim environments.\n\nOnce connected to a Raven fluid pipe network, the obelisk can store pure Raven fluid and consume large amounts of it to release map-wide pulses for corpse recycling, stimulation, or consciousness dampening. The pink meat broth produced by corpse recycling will be stored inside as a liquid and can be sent to industrial equipment for processing via the pipe output.
LanguageData.Raven_Mote_ObeliskGoldenPulse.label: (Raven) Obelisk Energy Pulse
